why: The other direction of the 2026-09-30 refinement of blocker (7), sibling-title ambiguity (compare-spec 2.17.0). A look-alike sibling under the same parent makes the proposal ambiguous when it ALSO carries the submission's anchor. Here the anchor is the DISTRIBUTION NUMBER (dates are year-only apart from the proposal's full date): the submission 'Finale (part 1)' is numbered 21, the proposal 'Finale' is 21, and the sibling 'Finale Part 1' is 21A. A trailing part letter is the SAME number for ambiguity, so 21A shares the anchor and the gate must hold the sole Accept for a reviewer rather than auto-clear a part to the whole. Found on the 16k drift guard (row Q50845708) by the refinement's first measurement. Fails if the gate is removed or if the part-letter rule is removed (both mutants verified by eidr-core). SCOPE: this fixture does NOT pin the shared FULL-DATE direction (two look-alike siblings on the same full date, no numbers); tests/test_sibling_title_anchor.py covers that in BMR-Review. The row's reason is not asserted.
